desc: Parse input and for each test case compute each cake's maximum value M_i and its base color (argmax coordinate, ties broken deterministically).
Sort cakes by M_i descending, select the top 2K as the base set S, compute the sum of M_i (sumM) and the parity of color counts.
If all color counts are even, output sumM directly.
Otherwise identify the two odd colors p,q and third color r, and build candidate ops (recolor / swap) per color pair, keeping a few cheapest per subtype.
Compute the minimum correction via a single op on edge {p,q}, or two disjoint ops on edges {p,r} and {q,r}, enforcing item disjointness.
Output sumM minus the minimum correction for each test case.
Verify on provided samples (both passed) and reasoning confirmed: reduction to even coloring, ≤2-op reduction via GF(2) edge argument, non-negative costs, and C≥2 candidate sufficiency.
